description: Fetch one Mattermost attachment into CallPilotAI's document store and return its document_id — retrieve the file itself with get_document_link. The bytes never pass through this call. The stored type is decided by the CONTENT, not by what Mattermost announces; a mismatch is reported. Max 25 MB per file, checked against the announced size before anything is transferred. Required: file_id (from list_mattermost_messages), entity and entity_id to file it against.

entity.description: lead | contact | account | campaign | user — what the document belongs to.

title.description: Optional title; defaults to the file name.

name: download_mattermost_file
